notes:
Bombs and staves finally show their damage. The numbers were never on the item - they live on whatever the attack spawns - and MegaLoad only followed that one hop, to the projectile. Dynamite's projectile deals nothing and merely explodes on contact, so it read as a weapon with no damage at all. The whole chain is followed now: Ember Charge is Blunt 140 over a 3m blast, Trollstav Fire 300 over 10m. Blast radius is listed beside the damage, because 140 blunt spread over three metres is not the same as 140 blunt on a swing. Items with resolved damage went from 10 to 30.

Summon staves get a Summons panel instead of an empty one. Dead Raiser, Spirit Caller and Trollstav genuinely deal no damage themselves - the thing they call up does the hitting - so rather than invent a number, the summon is named and links through to it. Spirit Caller calls Bear, Moose, Wolf and Boar spirits.

One honest gap: Northern Vengeance still shows no damage. There is none anywhere in its chain and it summons nothing visible, so it is left blank rather than guessed at.
